items.q: Will the ad copy get me results?
items.a: It gives you well-formed starting lines that fit the limits. Results depend on your offer, audience and landing page, so test two or three versions and keep the best.

items.q: Should I use the lines exactly as generated?
items.a: Edit them. Add your real offer, price, location or proof, because specific lines almost always beat generic ones.
No. There is no sign-up or login, and you can generate as many versions as you like.

items.q: Can I learn to write ads that convert?
items.a: Yes. Our Digital Marketing course teaches Google Ads and Meta Ads copy, creatives and testing on live campaigns.
